habitats.name: 公园安静鸟舍
habitats.flightPolicy: All routes are bidirectional, preserve every point. Perch route numeric IDs map to perch-N nodes. Access routes use string node IDs. Swept body sphere root+[0,.20,0], radius .18; static town plus declared bird props validated at <=.10m samples.

humanNavigation.scope: Public paving plus validated habitat connectors; no roads traffic simulation, indoor or upper-floor navigation.
